headline: Two of your assets (BrandPulse, Claude Eats Tokens) are being cloned this week by 0-3 star repos. Same lesson: measure then ship the fix. Rivals only measure. That's your edge.

moves.title: Turn your free checker into a paid 290€ report
moves.intro: BrandPulse already does 80% of this (generate_report.py + index.html are live). You add a fix-list + a price, not a rebuild.

steps.t: Add a 'fix list' to the report
steps.paste: In generate_report.py, add a section 'Top 3 fixes to get cited by AI' — per missing query: the gap + one concrete action (schema / content / entity). Keep my existing style.
steps.done: report.html shows 3 fixes under the score

steps.t: Put a price on the landing
steps.how: Add one line under the headline in index.html:
steps.paste: Free score in 60s. Full report + fix plan: 290€ — delivered in 48h.

steps.how: Run BrandPulse on 3 FR B2B brands, DM each founder (swap [X]):
steps.paste: J'ai checké la visibilité de [X] dans ChatGPT vs vos concurrents — voici le rapport. Le plan de correction, je le fais pour 290€. Ça vous intéresse ?

moves.unlocks: 1 paying client → 79€/mo monitoring (recurring = the real money).
moves.miss: Profound/Peec only measure. You ship the fix (you generate code). Lead with it.
moves.cross: Same 'measure → fix' playbook powers the Claude Eats Tokens move. Build it once, reuse twice.

moves.title: Pick the ONE wedge the 3 clones don't have
moves.intro: 3 trackers shipped in 8 days. Don't match features — take the angle they're weak on: forecasting.

steps.how: Open cctally's README, copy its cost-per-percent formula into a note.
steps.done: you can state in 1 sentence how cctally computes cost — and where it's loose

steps.t: Write your wedge on the landing
steps.paste: Know if you can keep going — before you hit the limit. Forecasts your 5h window, not just past spend.
steps.done: the forecast promise is the H1 on your PWA

steps.paste: The hidden cost of Claude Code: most devs can't see it until the limit hits. Here's how I forecast mine →
steps.done: 1 post live, links to your PWA

moves.unlocks: Reframes you from 'made a tracker' to 'I quantify LLM cost' — a hireable skill.
moves.miss: All 3 clones report the past. None forecast the future window. Forecasting is the wedge.

skill_up: GEO (Generative Engine Optimization = how a brand shows up inside AI answers). 1h on the 'best GEO tools 2026' list + one demo, then write one paragraph defining it. Upgrades your pitch and your CV at once.
